subject: Pod orientation + sightline risk assessment for Booth P34
messages:
From: Lila Nguyen <lila.nguyen@expo-co.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Site Survey Team <sitesurvey@expo-co.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pod orientation + sightlines — Booth P34

Hi Olga,

Quick follow-up from the site survey this morning. Your confirmed footprint for P34 is 20' x 10' (corner pod on Hall B aisle). We noted three potential sightline risks based on neighboring islands and the main thoroughfare:

- A raised demo table directly opposite the main aisle (blocks view if your screen faces the aisle)
- A structural column 6' from your back-left corner
- A hanging banner planned for the center aisle (may obscure tall signage)

Can you confirm whether you want the pod oriented to face the main aisle or rotate toward the exhibit center? We need confirmation by end of day so we can finalize power and rigging placements.

Attachments: floorplan_v3.pdf (PDF, 890 KB); site_photos_panorama.zip (images)

Thanks,
Lila Nguyen

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pod orientation + sightlines — Booth P34

Thanks Lila — good notes and helpful photos.

Proposed orientation (internal recommendation): face the main aisle with the demo counter staggered 3' back from the aisle edge. Rationale: maximizes walk-by visibility, keeps the demo screen at eye line for passersby, and reduces the risk of column interference when we place our backwall 2' off the column.

Action items for internal sign-off and follow-up:
- Marissa: confirm signage artwork sizes for two 7' roll-ups and one 8' hanging sign (we may need to shrink hanging sign if it conflicts with ExpoCo banner).
- Jonas: confirm power feed routing to the demo kiosk and whether the PDU can be located under the demo counter (see proposed markup attached).
- Alex: confirm collateral placement and crate arrival date so we can reserve storage near the dock.

I'll attach a quick markup (pod_markup_olga.pdf) showing the proposed counter offset and sightline arrows. If we need to rotate toward the exhibit center, we should be prepared to elevate signage 6" higher to stay visible. Please reply with yes/no plus any constraints.

Best,
Olga

Redwood Inference
PM: +1 206-555-0144

Olga — approve orientation to face the main aisle. A few quick confirmations from marketing/logistics: 

- Collateral: 350 one-pagers, 120 datasheets, 50 demo keys (small acrylic boxes). Shipping ETA to advance warehouse: 2026-07-20.
- Signage: we will ship two 7' rollups and one 8' hanging sign. If hanging sign needs to be reduced, we can accept 7' instead of 8' but prefer not to go below 7'. Final artwork deadline: 2026-07-02.
- Staffing: Booth lead will be Alex; schedule to follow.

One ask for ops: can ExpoCo confirm crate handling times? We prefer dock hold until noon Monday to ensure staging.

—Marissa

Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com, Lila Nguyen <lila.nguyen@expo-co.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pod orientation + sightlines — Booth P34

Quick technical check from production:

- Power: booth will require one 20A circuit for demo laptop/monitor and one shared 20A circuit for lighting + phone chargers. ExpoCo power can be run to the left-side floor box; running a cable across the aisle is not permitted.
- Rigging: no heavy hanging LED arrays — ceiling load in that zone is 75 lbs per point and our hanging sign (8') with frame would exceed safe margin. If you want overhead visibility, use a tension fabric flag (lightweight) or raise the rollups on 6" risers.
- AV placement: demo monitor should be mounted on a low swivel stand at 42" height and located 3' from the aisle to avoid blocking foot traffic.

I've attached the site power matrix with labeled floor boxes. I'll update the markup (embedded comments) and upload to the shared Drive. If we need to change orientation after rigging deadline (2026-07-10) there will be a late-change fee.

Jonas Weber
Exhibits Production Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: site_power_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 64 KB)
